You are a repo fix worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the OBE podcast repo (/mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast) at HEAD — edit files here directly.

OWNERSHIP BOUNDARY: you own exactly two paths: scripts/run_podcast_loop.sh and tests/test_run_podcast_loop_card_lane.py. Nothing else. Never touch .git, never commit, never run git add; leave changes uncommitted. Do NOT modify scripts/funnel_status.py or scripts/funnel_evidence.py.

CONTEXT — a design collision proven in production on 2026-08-05: in run_podcast_loop.sh (~lines 120-137), the guest-acquisition preflight runs funnel_status.py --json --output <snapshot> and treats ANY nonzero exit as a failed focus chain (FOCUS_RC), skipping funnel_evidence.py focus and downgrading the worker to runbook ordering. But funnel_status.py's report_exit_code() (funnel_status.py lines 727-737, read-only reference) returns 2 BY DESIGN whenever any funnel report section has red findings — a linter-style findings signal; the snapshot is still written correctly. Net effect: the funnel tollgate system disables itself precisely when the funnel has problems, which is exactly when its prioritized focus list matters most. Every 2026-08-05 receipt shows 'focus chain FAILED (rc=2)' while the engine was healthy.

CHANGE (minimal, in the preflight block only): treat funnel_status exit code 2 as SUCCESS-WITH-FINDINGS for chain purposes — proceed to funnel_evidence.py focus whenever funnel_status exits 0 OR (exits 2 AND the snapshot file exists and is non-empty). Any other nonzero exit, or a missing/empty snapshot, remains a real chain failure with the existing degrade-never-block fallback text. Keep the FOCUS_DUTY strings' meaning intact; you may add a short parenthetical to the success duty noting when the snapshot carried red findings (e.g. 'funnel red findings present — the focus list is the repair order'). Update the comment block above to document the exit-code contract (0 = green, 2 = findings, else = failure) with a pointer to report_exit_code. Preserve set -euo pipefail safety: capture the exit code without letting it abort the script (the existing '|| FOCUS_RC=$?' pattern).

TESTS: extend tests/test_run_podcast_loop_card_lane.py (source-contract style, it already parses the script's text): add test functions asserting (1) the preflight source contains the findings-tolerant condition — exit 2 with an existing snapshot proceeds to funnel_evidence.py focus (assert on the actual shell text you wrote, e.g. the rc-2 branch and the snapshot existence check appear inside the guest-acquisition preflight block); (2) a NEGATIVE case: a poisoned copy of the script with the old strict '[ "$FOCUS_RC" -eq 0 ]'-only gate (and no rc-2 tolerance) FAILS your new assertion, proving the test can catch regression; (3) the existing deliver_escalation_once card-lane tests still pass untouched.

HOW TO RUN (from the worktree root — all must pass): bash -n scripts/run_podcast_loop.sh && PLACEHOLDER_MODE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_run_podcast_loop_card_lane.py tests/test_tg_approval.py -q -p no:cacheprovider

HARD RULES: smallest possible diff, do not touch deliver_escalation_once or any send/telegram code, no new dependencies, never invoke any network, model CLI, MCP, or skill, leave changes uncommitted — the harness exports the diff.
